$comment: Metric definitions for scripts/metrics/log-metrics.mjs. Each entry: name (Prometheus-compatible), description/help, type counter|gauge|histogram, match (array of {field, op, value} clauses over JSON fields — dot paths like 'error.type' allowed; ops: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, exists), groupBy (fields promoted to labels), value (numeric field for histogram/gauge), buckets (histogram upper bounds). See docs/observability/log-based-metrics.md.

metrics.name: spindle_log_lines_total
metrics.description: Total parsed JSON log lines by level

metrics.name: spindle_error_log_lines_total
metrics.description: Log lines at error/fatal level (all events, not just requests)

metrics.name: spindle_db_query_duration_ms
metrics.description: Database query duration from db.query log lines

metrics.name: spindle_worker_job_failures_total
metrics.description: Failed background worker jobs (event=worker.job with level error/fatal)
